title: Outbreak Picks
heading: The clips so far, and the crane's step
intro: Each frame only gets about 1.5 s in the cut (32 beats over 7 frames), so a clip passes if it has 1.5–3 clean seconds. My verdict is under each one. The step still needs your OK before I spend video credits on it.

sections.h: The crane takes a step (new still)
sections.lede: Three tries at the clip all kept the legs planted. Fallback: a still with the leg already lifted, then animate it coming down.

groups.title: Lifted-leg still
groups.line: My pick: c. The left leg is bent and lifted with tarmac falling off it. In a, the wheels float like a separate object.

opts.label: c: leg lifted at the knee

sections.lede: Most dramatic real-camera option per frame, Omni 1.2 Flash, 8 s each.

groups.title: 2 · Fire down the lanes
groups.line: Pass. Cars morph a little around the blast: cut ~2 s there.

groups.title: 3 · Tower cranes pull free
groups.line: My pick: r2, first 3 s only (right tower smears after). r3 fails: jibs flicker and multiply.

groups.title: 4 · The rank walks
groups.line: My pick: r3. Solid steel, the leg base blasts out of the road. Still no actual step: see the still above.

groups.title: 7 · Empty driver's seat
groups.line: Pass with a trim: first 3.5 s are clean. At ~3.7 s Omni fakes a dissolve to a windscreen view, so cut before it.
